name: SaSame GEC

overview.text: SaSame GEC presents an outcome-work entry for people and AI, with private drafts, explicit permission boundaries and independent checking. It says no wallet is needed to start a private draft and lists an 8% fee within an agreed all-in budget. Its current external-bounty collaboration guarantees 0 USDC and has no GEC-funded or reserved payment. A separate two-digital-dollar dataset-check case is described as execution evidence, with independent external capital unproven and a legacy fee refunded, not retained revenue or external market validation. Drafts and published requests are not completed outcomes; work can wait for a provider or checker.

disclosure: Disclosure: this card was proposed by SaSame's own GitHub account (shigeki7777, SRL SaSame) in GitHub issue #67.
